recent.text: The #NYR won their first game in 1,114 days at the #Flames Saddle Dome last night in the clubs last visit to the famed arena.
recent.author: Matthew Mugno
recent.quoted_text: When visiting the #Flames, the #NYR have lost their last three games. They’ve been outscored 11-5 in those contests. The clubs last win in CGY was on 10/24/23. That was 1,114 days ago.

recent.text: As we head to Vancouver for the final leg of the trip, here are 10 observations from #NYR’s 3-1 win in Calgary — on Korpisalo’s incredible save, an emerging goalie tandem, Zibanejad’s scoring touch in the Dome, a final thought on Othmann and much more 👇🏼 https://t.co/kAqZ4mMQ4p

recent.text: Mika Zibanejad is 11 goals from 300, four assists from 400, and 15 points from 700 as a #NYR. He trails Mark Messier by six points on the franchise all time points list. Eclipsing Messier gets Mika into the top five. He could do that before Thanksgiving. He trails Chris Kreider

recent.text: Zibanejad also said this was a purposeful shot, not a pass attempt. "I tried to bank it off of him, because I felt like he came out. He left the post, I guess. I just try to put it in there, hoping that he backs into it. And luckily, it worked this time." #NYR

recent.text: #NYR Joonas Korpisalo said he intentionally dropped his stick to make that sprawling save on Zayne Parekh. "That was a heck of a play by him. He got me swimming. It's just straight desperation. Dropped my stick to get my leverage, get my blocker there and I got lucky."
recent.author: Mollie Walker

recent.text: #NYR Mika Zibanejad said that he meant to bank the puck off Flames goalie Devin Cooley on this play, not pass. "I felt like he came out, he left the post I guess. Just try to put it in there, hoping that he backs in it. Luckily, it worked this time." https://t.co/AJg88Ifjss
